figures.finding: The Swedish Film Institute's production support for a feature (at least 60 minutes) goes to a production company with an established producer who has made at least one feature or a 6 x 30-minute drama series with approved distribution; it is decided by the CEO on a film commissioner's assessment, paid in five instalments, and repaid from the producer's income at the support's share of the budget once income reaches 135% of approved private capital, for at most five years after release; in 2025 the Institute's average share of supported features' financing was 28%.

value.supportFor: Swedish feature film, at least 60 minutes, before completion
value.producerRequirement: at least one feature or a drama series of at least 6 x 30 minutes with approved distribution
value.decision: CEO of the Swedish Film Institute on a film commissioner's assessment

repayment.startsWhen: producer income reaches 135% of approved private capital and 100% of licences and minimum guarantees sold

figures.applies: Sweden; Swedish majority feature films applying to the Swedish Film Institute; guidelines adopted 19 April 2018, revised 24 February 2026; statistics for 2025.

sources.said: Med etablerad producent avses en fysisk person som har producerat minst en lång spelfilm eller en dramaserie om minst 6 x 30 minuter. … Återbetalningen startar när producentens totala intäkter uppnår 135 procent på i förhand godkänt privatkapital samt 100 procent på försålda licenser och minimigarantier.

Filminstitutets genomsnittliga andel finansiering av långa spelfilmer med produktionsstöd 2025 … 28% … 2025 fördelade Filminstitutet ordinarie stöd till 14 långa spelfilmer och 6 långa spelfilmer inom ramen för Moving Sweden/talangsatsningar. … Medianbudgeten ökade från cirka 28 miljoner kronor 2024 till 36 miljoner 2025.

figures.finding: Sweden's production incentive, run by Tillväxtverket, refunds at most 25% of eligible costs spent in Sweden, up to SEK 10 million a production, for a feature with a total budget of at least SEK 30 million (SEK 10 million for a documentary) and at least SEK 4 million of eligible costs; where applications outrun the money, the largest eligible spends are granted first.

value.administeredBy: Tillväxtverket (Swedish Agency for Economic and Regional Growth)
value.eligibleCosts: goods and services from business taxed in Sweden, or wages of employees taxable in Sweden

figures.applies: Sweden; companies whose main business is audiovisual production; applications before production in Sweden starts; text as amended by SFS 2026:804, in force 1 July 2026.

sources.said: 7 § Stöd får ges med högst 25 procent av stödberättigande kostnader, dock med högst 10 000 000 kronor per produktion.

figures.finding: In a budget for Swedish Film Institute support the producer may charge an administrative mark-up of at most 7% of the budget or SEK 2 million, and members of the producers' association pay it 0.25% of the approved budget (at most SEK 75,000) on every supported feature.

producersAssociationLevy.on: approved production budget of features granted SFI production support

value.guidelineDated: 2017-03-24 (file name), still linked from the production support page on 2026-11-01

figures.applies: Sweden; budgets of films applying for Swedish Film Institute production support.

sources.said: Detta konto avser det administrativa påslag som producenten enligt Filminstitutets regelverk har rätt att ta ut om högst 7% av budgeten eller max 2 000 000 sek. … Medlemmar i Film & TV-Producenterna faktureras en avgift på 0,25 % av den godkända produktionsbudgeten (max 75 000) för samtliga långfilmer som beviljas produktionsstöd från Filminstitutet.

figures.finding: 19 Swedish features opened in cinemas in 2025, the fewest since 2021, 13 of them with Film Institute production support; Swedish films took 12% of admissions.

sources.said: 19 svenska spelfilmer hade premiär 2025, vilket var lägsta siffran sedan pandemiåret 2021. 13 av filmerna har fått produktionsstöd från Filminstitutet.

figures.finding: Swedish producers are organised in Film & TV-Producenterna, whose members pay the association 0.25% of the approved budget (at most SEK 75,000) of each feature the Film Institute supports.
figures.applies: Sweden; the association's own admission terms were not read (blocker).

sources.said: Medlemmar i Film & TV-Producenterna faktureras en avgift på 0,25 % av den godkända produktionsbudgeten (max 75 000) för samtliga långfilmer som beviljas produktionsstöd från Filminstitutet.

figures.finding: Film&TV-Producenterna, the trade association of Swedish film and TV production companies, has about 110 member companies with about SEK 5 billion of combined turnover (2025).
figures.applies: Sweden, production companies in film and television, as stated in the association's consultation response of 26 June 2025.

sources.said: Film&TV-Producenterna YTTRANDE Dnr: Ku2025/00320 2025-06-26 … Organisationen har för närvarande ca 110 medlemsbolag som tillsammans omsätter ca 5 miljarder kronor och representerar merparten av svensk film- och tv-produktion.

figures.finding: In 2023 the Swedish Film Institute gave about SEK 192 million in production support (SEK 117 million to feature fiction), backing 13 feature fiction films at about SEK 7.4 million each; its market support, abolished from 1 January 2025, had paid up to 30% of the budget of films costing at least SEK 20 million.
figures.applies: Sweden, Swedish Film Institute production support 2023, as summarised by the government inquiry SOU 2025:24 from the institute's pages; applications received are not given.
